long_biography.plain_text:
Raised in Kalamazoo, Michigan, Prestage entered agribusiness as an animal-feed salesman for Central Soya. An assignment took him and Marsha to North Carolina, where customer Ottis Carroll became his business partner. Their Carroll's Foods operation expanded across turkey and swine production and gave Prestage the experience to establish a family enterprise.

In 1983, Prestage purchased a Swift turkey operation and feed mill with Marsha and their sons. The new Prestage Farms expanded from North Carolina into several states, adding feed mills, hatcheries and processing plants while remaining family owned across three generations. Prestage served as founder and president until his death in 2022. The National Pork Producers Council later inducted him into its Hall of Fame for his influence on production standards, sustainability and animal care.
